Definition
[Classical Solution]

↗ def:kth-order-pde

1. ch1:1.3.1-def-2\group Well-Posedness

For a PDE of order $k$, a classical solution is a solution that is at least $k$ times continuously differentiable, so that all derivatives occurring in the equation exist and are continuous.
